booking.howItWorks: Talk to the events team to book a party. For corporate/group events, leagues, tournaments and fundraisers, call the sales office at (336) 292-0181, 9 AM - 5 PM every day.

packages.name: Birthday Party Special
packages.description: Bowling birthday party. Ranges from $16.95 to $20.95 plus tax per guest depending on time of day, the package chosen and how many attend. Minimum of eight participants, no maximum. $25 deposit goes towards the total price.

packages.name: Bowling
packages.description: Bowling rate listed as $5.00 Sunday-Thursday (the website does not say if this is per game or per person). Shoe rental $4.50. Friday-Saturday rate not listed.

packages.name: Corporate & Group Events
packages.description: Corporate and group events. Call the sales office (336) 292-0181, 9 AM - 5 PM every day, for details.

packages.name: Fundraisers
packages.description: Two different types of fundraisers. Bring your group in, have fun and raise money for your favorite cause. Call the sales office for more information and to schedule.

packages.name: Daycare & School Field Trips
packages.description: Field trips for youth groups of 10 or more, available Monday-Friday 9 AM - 5 PM. Four packages available; see the Field Trips page for details and pricing.

addOns.name: Locker Rental (per year)
addOns.description: Fill out a locker request form at the front counter.

faq.q: How much does a birthday party cost?
faq.a: Our Birthday Special ranges from $16.95 to $20.95 plus tax per guest depending on time of day, the package chosen and how many attend the bowling party. There is a $25 deposit that goes towards the total price of the party. There is just a minimum of eight participants and no maximum.

faq.q: How can I get a locker?
faq.a: Go to front counter and fill out a locker request form. Locker rentals are $30 per year.

faq.q: How do I get information about leagues, tournaments or corporate/group events?
faq.a: Call the sales office: 9 AM - 5 PM every day, (336) 292-0181.

faq.q: How often are the lanes oiled?
faq.a: The lanes are generally oiled daily and before one of bowling leagues or tournament events.

faq.q: Do you offer field trips for schools, daycares or camps?
faq.a: Yes! We offer field trips for youth groups of 10 or more. They are available Monday – Friday 9 AM – 5 PM. We have four packages available.
